_comment: Contract v2 shared by the renderer (scenes_lib.js), the verifier, the storyboard director and the web app. v2 adds BEATS (small timed actions so a scene is never static), the Al-Kahf scene pack (cave, dog, sleepers, man, ruler, wall, rock, fish, barrier...) and their events.
rules: Allah is never depicted in any form, not as light, not as a figure, not as a voice-source.
Prophets are drawn ONLY as labelled light drops (type 'prophet'). Angels ONLY as golden light drops (type 'angel'). Never as people.
Maryam and the Mothers of the Believers are drawn ONLY as labelled light drops (type 'honored'), never as women.
The unseen (Paradise, Hell, the Day of Judgement, the Throne, Jinn, the grave, the Hereafter) is never illustrated literally: use the 'ambient' scene for those passages.

Owner decision 2026-11-21: rulings, du'a, admonition and descriptions of people are shown on the stage as everyday life of faceless people (prayer, charity, family, trade, travel, work) whenever a this-world picture fits; the 'ambient' scene is only for Allah's names and attributes, the unseen and battles.
Where the Quran leaves a number to Allah's knowledge, never show a countable group (use 'sleepers', which is drawn uncountable).
Killing and violence are never shown; use the 'ambient' scene for such verses.
No text is baked into the art; the only scene text is the prophet/angel name label.

beats.description: params.beats = [{at:[verse,word], do, who, to}]: small actions on a word so the picture keeps moving. Aim for one beat every 3-6 s of recitation; at most 24 per chapter; at least 0.8 s apart. The renderer also adds gentle automatic camera moves wherever no beat happens for 5 s.

camera.shot_wide: camera eases back to show the whole stage
camera.shot_close: camera eases in on 'who' (an actor id or an anchor)
camera.shot_sky: camera tilts up toward the sky
camera.shot_ground: camera tilts down toward the ground
camera.pan_left: camera drifts to the left part of the stage
camera.pan_right: camera drifts to the right part of the stage
camera.push_in: slow dramatic push-in on the centre

actor.turn: who turns to face the other way
actor.point: who points toward 'to' (left|center|right or an actor id)
actor.bow: who lowers the head (humility, sorrow, regret)
actor.pray: who stands in prayer (seen from the side, hands folded); then ruku / sujud / sit / rise change the posture; stand_up or walk_to ends the prayer
actor.ruku: who bows in prayer (back level, hands on knees)
actor.sujud: who prostrates in prayer (forehead on the ground)
actor.rise: who rises back to standing in prayer
actor.give: who hands a small purse to 'to' (an actor id or a place): charity, a gift, paying what is due
actor.read: who holds an open book and reads
actor.speak: who speaks: small sound waves near the head (dialogue)
actor.look_up: who looks up to the sky
actor.wring_hands: who turns the hands over in regret

scene.birds: a few birds take off and cross the sky
scene.wind: a gust: grass, robes and dust move
scene.sparkle: a soft sparkle on 'who' (actor id or anchor), or the centre
scene.clouds_part: clouds part and light comes through

ambient.light_up: the light swells for a moment
ambient.wither: plants dry and scatter in the wind
ambient.pattern_turn: a new ring of the pattern lights up (geometric)
ambient.ink_waves: flowing dark lines spread over the sea like ink (sea)

motifs.description: Motion graphics v3. params.motifs = [{at:[verse,word], until:[verse,word]|null, motif, place, size, exit?}] on any scene. A motif is a line-art symbol on a cream plate with a gold ring: it draws itself on at the word that names the concept, lives (breathes with every recited word, has its own motion and particles), then leaves at 'until', when the next motif takes its place (match cut), or at the chapter end. At least 0.8 s between motif starts; at most 16 per chapter. Never a face or an eye; nothing for Allah or His attributes as a figure (use 'geometric' or 'light'); nothing literal for the unseen ('fire' is worldly fire only, never Hell).

library.book: an open book: the Book, revelation, a record, knowledge
library.scroll: a written scroll: a decree, a record of deeds, a message
library.pen: a reed pen and inkwell: writing, knowledge, decree, the words of Allah as a parable (18:109)
library.scales: a balance that tilts: justice, weighing deeds (as a symbol), fairness
library.hourglass: sand running: time, a term, delay, the passing of life
library.two_paths: a road that forks, one path lit: choice, guidance or misguidance
library.door: an arched door that opens on light: opportunity, entering, refuge
library.key: a key: the keys of the unseen as a symbol, opening, solution
library.lamp: an oil lamp with a living flame: guidance, light of faith
library.candle: a candle: light in darkness, patience, a lone believer
library.sun: the sun with turning rays: day, a sign, time, the sun's course
library.moon: a crescent: night, months, signs in the sky
library.stars: three twinkling stars: night, guidance by the stars, signs
library.cloud_rain: a cloud with falling rain: rain, mercy, reviving land
library.drop: a water drop with ripples: water, life, creation from water
library.wave: three moving waves: the sea, its vastness, trials
library.growth: seed, sprout, then a tree: growth, provision, reward, life after death as a parable
library.leaf: a falling leaf: this world's beauty that passes, decay
library.mountain: a snow-capped mountain with mist: steadfastness, the earth, majesty
library.wind: curling wind lines: wind, scattering, change
library.jewel: a gem: adornment, beauty of this world
library.crown: a crown: kingship, power, pride (never on a prophet)
library.house: a house with a lit window: home, family, dwelling
library.ship: a rocking ship: ships, journeys at sea, rescue
library.fish: a swimming fish (no eye): the sea, Musa's fish, provision
library.cave: a cave mouth: refuge, the cave of the youths
library.dog: a dog lying with forelegs stretched (no eye): the dog of the cave
library.hands: two raised open hands (hands only): du'a, supplication, humility
library.chains: a chain breaking apart: freedom, release (never punishment)
library.burst: an eight-point star burst with turning rays: a sign, a miracle, glad tidings
library.crowd: an uncountable crowd of faceless silhouettes: people, nations, a gathering
library.geometric: turning Islamic geometric star: Allah's names and attributes, tawhid, perfection (abstract)
library.light: rays of light from above: guidance, revelation, mercy
library.palm: a date palm with fruit: provision, gardens of this world, Maryam's palm
library.wheat: an ear of grain: provision, harvest, multiplying reward
library.fire: a worldly fire with embers: fire as a tool or a sign in this world ONLY
library.lightning: a cloud with a lightning bolt: thunder, fear and hope, power in nature
library.footsteps: footprints appearing one by one: a journey, following, walking
library.bricks: a brick wall: building, a wall, a barrier
library.bird: a flying bird (no eye): birds, freedom, signs in the sky
library.night_day: a disc half night, half day, turning: the alternation of night and day
library.river: a winding river: rivers, flowing water, gardens
library.seal: a round seal with a star: a covenant, a promise, sealing

transitions.description: params.transition = how this chapter enters (default 'dissolve'). Forward motion follows the right-to-left reading direction. Prefer match cuts: end a chapter on a motif and open the next chapter with the same or a related motif at the same place.

ambient.description: Calm, non-figurative background that breathes with the recitation (soft light pulses on each word). Safe for every passage. Beats allowed: camera beats, 'scene' beats birds/wind/sparkle/clouds_part/leaves, and the 'ambient' beats.

night_sky.label: Night sky & crescent
night_sky.use: reflection, mercy, signs at night, the unseen, the Hereafter (non-literal)

dawn.label: Dawn over the dunes
dawn.use: hope, relief after hardship, guidance, beginnings

sea.label: Calm sea
sea.use: signs in the sea, ships, provision, patience

garden.label: Palms & a river
garden.use: provision, gratitude, blessings of this world (NOT a depiction of Paradise)

rain.label: Rain on the land
rain.use: rain, reviving dead land, mercy, resurrection as a parable

geometric.label: Geometric pattern
geometric.use: Allah's names and attributes, tawhid, the Quran, the unseen, rulings

stage.description: A simple flat-vector story stage: one setting, a few actors, timed events and beats. Use it for every passage about this world: stories of prophets and nations, the deeds of believers, hypocrites and disbelievers, rulings shown as everyday life (prayer, charity, family, trade, travel), and signs in nature (rain, ships, gardens, fields). Use 'ambient' only for Allah's names and attributes, the unseen and battles.

garden.label: Gardens & farms (vines, palms, crops, a river between)

cave.label: Inside a cave, the bright entrance on one side

cave_mouth.label: Rocky mountainside with a cave entrance

pass.label: A narrow pass between two high mountains

sea_junction.label: Where two seas meet, a large rock on the shore

home.label: Inside a home: plastered walls, a lattice window (sky by time of day), a hanging lamp, cushions and a rug

prison.label: A plain prison cell: stone walls, one small high window, a bare floor with a straw mat (no bars, chains or guards)

prayer_hall.label: A prayer hall: an arcade of arches, hanging lamps, a green carpet with straight rows (no Kaaba, no writing)

market.label: A market street: stalls with striped awnings, sacks of grain, baskets of fruit, jars

fields.label: Fields of wheat swaying, palms at the edges (growth/wither change them)

poses.walk: walks slowly from its side toward the centre
poses.flee: runs from the centre toward its side and off the stage
poses.gather: a tight group that sways, heads turning

stage.uncountable: optional actor flag 'uncountable': true for group actors: drawn as overlapping silhouettes partly hidden by shadow, rocks or the frame edge, so the number cannot be counted (e.g. the youths of the cave, 18:22)

king.label: Tyrant king / Pharaoh (faceless)
king.note: label «فرعون» (never drawn) gives Pharaoh's Egyptian headdress; otherwise leave the label empty for a crowned king

ruler.label: Righteous ruler (faceless, dignified white and green robes, simple turban; never the tyrant look)

man.label: One faceless man; set 'look': plain | rich (fine robes, gold trim) | poor (simple patched robe) | traveller (staff and bundle)

sleepers.label: Sleepers lying under cloaks, drawn as an uncountable shadowed group (count must be 1)

dog.label: A dog (with pose 'sit' or 'sleep': lying at the entrance, forelegs stretched)

fish.label: A fish in a small basket (see event fish_escape)

rock.label: A large rock to rest by

wall.label: An old wall leaning, about to collapse (see event wall_repair)

barrier.label: The place of the barrier between the two mountains (see event barrier_build); use with setting 'pass', place 'center'

events.storm: dark clouds, strong wind and blowing dust
events.flood: water rises and covers the ground
events.stones: stones rain down from the sky
events.blast: a mighty blast: white flash and shake (the Sayha)
events.sea_part: the sea splits into a dry path between two walls of water (sea_shore setting)
events.light: a soft beam of light from above (guidance, rescue)
events.growth: plants sprout and the land turns green
events.sun_arc: sunlight passes the cave entrance from one side to the other without touching the sleepers (cave setting)
events.turn_sleepers: the sleepers shift from one side to the other
events.wither: the garden is destroyed: vines collapse on their trellises, fruit falls, the land turns barren
events.fish_escape: the fish slips from its basket into the sea, leaving a tunnel-like trail in the water
events.ship_hole: a plank is pulled from the ship, leaving a hole
events.wall_repair: the leaning wall is straightened and restored
events.barrier_build: iron blocks stack up between the mountains, glow red-hot in a fire, then molten copper is poured over them
events.sunset_far: the sun sinks toward a dark water horizon, as it appears to the eye
events.sunrise_open: the sun rises over an open plain with no shelter from it; with until=v:w it sets (sinks below the horizon) at that word
events.moonrise: (night only) no moon in the sky before the event; then the crescent rises from the horizon to its place; with until=v:w it sets (sinks below the horizon) at that word
